room.yard.title: Yard
room.yard.description: A packed-earth yard. A road leads north.
room.road.title: Road
room.road.description: A cobbled road. It runs east toward a ford.
room.ford.title: Ford
room.ford.description: A ford, road and mire. Stones cross the water east to a fen.
room.fen.title: Fen
room.fen.description: A sucking fen. The ground gives under every step.
